cases.assertion: A regular post with a single-choice poll and a group post with a multiple-choice poll round-trip valid options and live counts.
Concurrent submissions from the same account leave only one ballot, and an expired poll cannot accept another vote.
Unknown options or multiple selections in a single-choice poll are rejected. A viewer outside the original post access scope cannot read or vote.
Explicit migrations create constraints without changing prior steps. Native poll operations check readiness without DDL.
